text: Lovely mug!. Very good reminder of God's presence and always "sufficient grace"!

product_metadata.title: Christian Art Gifts Ceramic Bible Verse Coffee & Tea Mug for Women: Sufficient Grace - 2 Corinthians 12:9-10 Inspirational Bible Verse Cup Floral Chrysanthemum Scripture Mug w/Pink Flowers, 12 oz.
features: 2 CORINTHIANS 12:9-10 BIBLE VERSE MUG: Christian Art Gift’s Flower Mug features an inspirational "His Grace Is Sufficient … " verse from 2 Corinthians 12:9-10, elegantly calligraphed over a beautiful, blooming flower. This elegant scripture mug is glazed inside and out.

PINK CHRYSANTHEMUM FLOWER DESIGN: Drink in God’s words. This floral mug is part of Christian Art Gift's bible verse mug collection that features captivating designs with lovely handwritten words painted on them. This “Grace” mug is not only functional; it also serves as a beautiful reminder of the gospel each time you take a moment to drink and meditate.

LEAD FREE, MICROWAVE & DISHWASHER SAFE: This Christian coffee cup is made of durable ceramic lead and cadmium-free glaze that ensures long-term and carefree usage. Easy to use and easy to clean, this Corinthians mug is Microwave & Dishwasher Safe. 12 Oz Capacity.

RELIGIOUS GIFT IDEA: Give an inspirational gift to your family, friends, brothers and sisters in Christ with this lovely Sufficient Grace mug that features a chrysanthemum flower art with intricate and thoughtful calligraphy design. Packaged with a pretty matching box this inspirational coffee cup makes an easy and useful gift for any occasion.

HIS GRACE IS SUFFICIENT FOR ME: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me…
